semiconductor_relevance: High — Yaskawa Europe Technology specializes in automation solutions for semiconductor fabrication, including robotics and handling systems.
summary: Yaskawa Europe Technology provides advanced automation solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on products such as robots, EFEMs, and wafer handling systems. Their expertise in motion control and customized automation systems enhances productivity and reliability in semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.Europe: Yaskawa Europe Technology serves the European market as the subsidiary of Yaskawa Electric Corporation from Japan.
